text: A successful repipe starts with understanding how the building’s water system connects.
Confirm the actual routes, access, and affected services before committing to a shutdown.
Protect the home, open the necessary areas, and prepare the new route.
Build the replacement distribution as an isolated system, coordinating cold water, hot water, and circulation return.
Complete the fixture branches, then test and inspect the new piping before service transfer.
Within a verified isolation boundary, transfer service, check the final connections, flush, and balance circulation.
After acceptance, restore penetrations and finishes, preserve service access, and document what is behind the walls.
A planned sequence. Restored service. A maintainable system.
